card.name: The word agency and its pieces
card.fires_on: The word agency or agencies, including the split-up forms like Ag-enc-ys and Ag-ence. It appears in government, space and health organization names and in general text.

modes.label: Split-up agency
modes.description: Fires on the middle piece of agency when the word is broken into parts after Ag or ag.

modes.label: Whole word agency
modes.description: Fires on agency or agencies as a complete word, for government bodies or in compounds.
